key_reasoning.reason: Three components in two areas: the hook-command utility gains an exec-form generator, BaseExtensionInstaller gains a refresh step that runs on every successful install, and ClaudePluginInstaller overrides it for Windows. The 'touches core shared utilities' red flag was considered and not applied: both shared-code changes are additive (a new pure function, a default no-op template hook), so no other agent's install behavior changes. The 14/15 boundary was resolved lower because Technical Risk is M and the existing localizeInstalledHooks / rewriteHooksCommandTree pair covers more than half the implementation.

Close precedent exists in the shell-form hook localization, but exec form (node binary as command, CLI script and arguments as args) is a new output shape that depends on Claude Code honouring args in hook entries, and the behavior is Windows-only. Failures are caught and logged, the installed file is left untouched on error, and a write happens only when content differs, so rollback is trivial. Edge cases are covered with the existing platform-spy test pattern, so no defensive-test bump.

6 files, 402 insertions, no deletions: three source files (utility, base installer, Claude installer) and three test files, one of them new. Roughly 60 lines are production code; the rest is test coverage.
